name: Pyun Pyun Heart Throbbing Endless Love Bakery
source:
You opened your bakery in Woodstown, hoping to find success. Unfortunately for you, there was already a successful bakery with nearly the entire town as regulars there. 

Throughout your struggles to stay afloat in the new life you've built, you meet reoccurring customers, face the thrill of potential romance, and get wrapped up in a heart pounding mystery. 

What will you do? 

How will you survive? 

But most importantly... 

Who will you choose?

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1205487879/pyun-pyun-heart-throbbing-endless-love-bakery]Kickstarter[/url]]

A spinoff of [url=https://aislebsoupid.itch.io/bonnies-bakery]Bonnie's Bakery[/url], which takes place in the same setting.
